newsitem.title: UK: European Diary for Advertising & Media to Aug 17.
newsitem.headline: European Diary for Advertising & Media to Aug 17.

text.p: REUTERS EUROPEAN DIARY OF EVENTS FOR ADVERTISING & MEDIA - to Aug 17, 1997
The following is a four-week diary of events covering advertising, marketing, media and the Internet in Europe.

ADVERTISING MARKETING EFFECTIVENESS - Global competition sponsored by The New York Festivals, designed to recognise effectiveness and creativity of advertising and marketing campaigns from a global vantage point. Entry fee $375. Deadline for entries: September 30, 1997. Contact: 1 914 238 4481. Web site: http://www.nyfests.com
MARKETING DESIGN AWARDS - Awards for the effective application of design to the marketing process. Awards in 23 categories. Deadline for Entries: Friday, August 29. Contact: (44) 171 413 4433.

LONDON - The Hard Commercial Edge of PR. Conference will examine growing importance of communications as a central, strategic business discipline and considers challenge for PR industry as communications moves upstream. Church House Conference Centre, Dean's yard, Westminster, London SW1. Contact: (44) 171 222 2348. (two-day conference July 24-25)

LONDON - The Hard Commercial Edge of PR. Conference will examine growing importance of communications as a central, strategic business discipline and considers challenge for PR industry as communications moves upstream. Church House Conference Centre, Dean's yard, Westminster, London SW1. Contact: (44) 171 222 2348. (two-day conference July 24-25)

LONDON - Creative Radio Workshop for Advertisers. How to encourage and assess good radio scripts; how to create a space for your brand on the airwaves; getting the best out of the "invisible" medium. Jointly conducted by the Incorporated Society of British Advertisers and the Radio Advertising Bureau. The London Business School, Sussex Place, Regent's Park, London NW1. Contact: (44) 171 306 2573

Please send entries to: Reuters Advertising & Media Diary, Advertising Newsdesk, Reuters Ltd, 85 Fleet Street (GIR/1), London EC4P 4AJ; fax (44) 171 542 2929; telephone (44) 171 542 2792; email: adnewslon@reuters.com.
